basic_info.description: Introducing the dreamy opportunity to own a top-floor gem in the heart of Mission Dolores. This sophisticated one-bedroom, one-bathroom TIC offers elegance with sleek finishes and a beautiful city view. Large bedroom closet with customized shelving, hardwood floors, common outdoor area in back, storage in the garage and at the back stairs. Ductless air conditioning/heat installed last year and new windows in 2022. Shared (free) laundry in garage. HOA covers trash, water, PG&E and quarterly cleaning of common areas, small maintenance items, and building insurance. Located one block from Whole Foods for absolute convenience, three blocks from gorgeous Dolores Park, and steps from all the Mission magic - cafes, restaurants, and nightlife. This home is everything you want in SF city living!
